data.title: Venera
data.about:
Following the successful launch of The Valley Phase 1, Emaar Properties proudly presents Venera at The Valley Phase 2. Inspired by the breathtaking beauty of nature and the thrill of adventure, this iconic townhouse cluster features rolling hills, lush meadows, tranquil rivers, picturesque valleys, and dense forests. Conveniently located off Dubai-Al Ain Road, Venera at The Valley Phase 2 aims to set a new standard for communities focused on nature, adventure, and quality living.

Venera offers modern 3 & 4-bedroom townhouses designed with floor-to-ceiling windows, bringing nature indoors. Winding trails lead through captivating landscapes, inviting explorers to discover hidden treasures around every corner. Amidst lush greenery, each home boasts high-quality finishes and stunning views. Becoming part of Venera means joining an established community with a reputable developer and enjoying access to upcoming amenities tailored for an active lifestyle.

Invest early in Venera's versatile townhouses and watch your property value grow in this desirable neighborhood. Phase 2 of Venera at The Valley offers everything you need for a fulfilling lifestyle.

characteristics_module.description:

  • Part of an Established Community: Become a part of the flourishing community at Venera at The Valley by Emaar.
  • Lush Greenery and Open Spaces: Delight in the lush landscaping and open spaces in Venera at The Valley in Dubai.
  • Close to Amenities: Enjoy access to nearby retail areas, sports facilities, and kids' play areas in Venera at The Valley by Emaar.
  • Convenient Location: Venera at The Valley offers seamless access to Dubai Al Ain Road.
  • Spacious and Efficient Designs: Reside in spacious, efficiently designed homes in Venera at The Valley by Emaar.
  • Largest Plot Sizes: Invest in the largest townhouse plots on the market at Venera at The Valley.
  • Secure Investment: Capitalize on the success of The Valley Phase 1 for a secure investment.
  • Flexible Payment Plan: Take advantage of a relaxed 80/20 payment plan, paying 20% annually.

location_tile.title: The Perfect Location at The Valley Phase 2
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Venera at The Valley boasts exceptional connectivity via Jebel Ali Lahbab Road, which begins at the Sheikh Zayed Road Interchange and extends to Emirates Road. This crucial corridor fuels rapid development by linking key areas such as Jebel Ali Industrial Area, JAFZA, Dubai South, DIP, and reaching the Expo 2020 site. The Valley Phase 2 Project by Emaar Properties, located in the heart of Dubai, is more than just a residential area—it's a thriving community worth investing in. With its scenic landscapes, premium amenities, and strategic location, living in Venera at The Valley by Emaar offers an unparalleled lifestyle in Dubai.

05 Minutes to Rugby Sevens Stadium
08 Minutes to Dubai Outlet Mall
25 Minutes to Burj Khalifa & Dubai Mall
25 Minutes to Dubai Int'l Airport

more_info.answer: While there are no schools directly within the Emaar Venera community, The Aquila School is the closest option, located approximately 11.9 km away in The Villa community. This school offers a British curriculum along with an IB program. Other nearby schools include GEMS FirstPoint School, also with a British curriculum, about 12.2 km away, and Lycée Français International Georges Pompidou.
